greet.speaker: cinder
greet.text: You came down for the singing. So did I, four hundred years ago, and it kept me. I am Cinder. I was a priest of the Echo before there was an Echo to be priest of. I do not breathe; please do not stare. Something down here holds my tether, and the drowned do not get to look for it alone. It turns out.

choices.text: [Hollow] I know the pull. Mine leads nowhere yet.

tether.speaker: cinder
tether.text: The thread the Weft forgot to cut. It runs from me to a thing in the deep that the Choir calls a Key. I remember the Sundering. I remember the Choir before it was drowned. Take me with you and I will tell you all of it, which is more than your Archive knows.

choices.text: Sera, you have buried people. Is he one?
We do not walk with the dead.

sera_call.speaker: sera
sera_call.text: I have carried out worse-looking men who were alive. He asked. That is more than the dead usually do. Bring him.

refused.speaker: cinder
refused.text: You came back. The dead are patient, and I am the patient dead. Is the answer different?

choices.text: It is different. Walk with us.

recruited.speaker: cinder
recruited.text: The tether pulls harder the deeper the Beacon reaches. It is not unpleasant. That is what worries me.

choices.text: We will cut it if you ask.
